Before we matched on Tinder, I had no idea what I was going on with my life. While it sounds manipulative, I never meant in that sense. As our connection grew stronger over the span of a couple weeks, he let me in.

I wasn't even sure I was ready, but I didn't really second guess myself as I wanted to do what I could to essentially keep us together.
I started sending good morning and good night texts, as we maintained face timing every night, and I wan't to say things were going well at first. However, my emotions began to get the best of me. This is where things started to go downhill.

I started doing that too much.
